limitations: Original activity.jsonl is untouched and remains the complete raw sample record.
CPU busy is derived from adjacent /proc/stat aggregate counter deltas.
Disk busy is the maximum whole-device cumulative io_ms delta divided by elapsed milliseconds; partition and loop devices are excluded. This avoids averaging away activity on one disk.

Unrelated CPU is a partial sampled-process estimate: adjacent utime+stime deltas only for processes present in both snapshots, excluding benchmark/monitor PID+start-time pairs recorded anywhere in new_processes. Short-lived/new/dying processes and process rows missing from snapshots are not covered. Process tick conversion is 100 ticks/sec, checked by a post-run getconf on the same rig.

Other-GPU contention takes the maximum sampled gpu_busy_percent excluding measured PCI 0000:03:00.0 and production GPUs 0000:c9:00.0/0000:cc:00.0 (physical indices 8/9); sampled GPU zero is a reported zero, missing telemetry is unknown.

Run interval sample counts include samples whose monotonic timestamp falls inclusively within start/end. Boundary offsets and nearest outside-sample gaps are reported; unobserved time is unknown, not zero.
Flag counts are sampled points at or above exact manifest thresholds, not durations or causal attribution. No performance pass/fail conclusion is made.

payload_control.scope: Payload identity for retained timing controls; does not prove identical driver compilation or timings.

payload_normalizer.initial_attempt: Rig build image lacks spirv-opt; initial proof attempt stopped at its first module, without inference. Inputs were copied and normalized locally instead.

interpretation: Q4_1 T64 main/old/fixed medians 717.9/771.9/716.3 us; Q4_0 715.4/790.0/717.7 us. Each retains three measured samples.
Q5 T64 improves 789.8 to 721.3 us and T128 743.4 to 685.4 us.
All 144 case cells remain in the record, including short control differences beyond 6 percent.

The route and RMSNorm controls have main-identical normalized payloads but discrete or broad timing variation. Q4 row payload differs in branch layout from main and is unchanged by the tile fix; no row-kernel regression waiver is inferred.

No sampled activity crosses the declared thresholds, including maximum per-disk busy. Sampling has gaps and partial process attribution; this does not establish an idle machine or prove the cause of variation.
Final model timing and remaining source/policy applicability checks remain open.
